title: Stockpiling at the Onset of the COVID-19 Pandemic: An Empirical Analysis of National Prescription Drug Sales and Prices
eligible_reason: Not a staggered design: Table 1 compares COVID-19-indicated drugs (treated) with control drugs before and after a single common onset (POST = March 2020 onward; POST_March..POST_Sep are month-specific interactions with the same onset). Every Table 1 column also includes time-varying controls (PRODUCER, VARIETY) and channel dummies. Table 2 is a product-level probit/IV analysis of shortage starts (instrument = pandemic). The shipped data are synthetic (IQVIA data proprietary).
design_notes: Drug-form x channel x month panel, Jan 2018 - Sep 2020 (IQVIA National Sales Perspectives). Table 1: plm within (index Drug_Form) of log(UNIT) and log(AVG.PRICE) on factor(M) + TIME*factor(category) + treated*POST (cols 1, 3) or treated*POST_<month> (cols 2, 4) + PRODUCER + VARIETY + factor(Channel), SE clustered by drug-form. One adoption date for all treated drugs. Table 2 (Stata): probit, xtivreg, ivreg2 of Shortage_Start on LnUnit instrumented by pandemic/treated, with time-varying controls.

specs.exclusion_reason: single common onset (March 2020) for all treated drugs; time-varying controls PRODUCER, VARIETY; synthetic data
single common onset (March 2020); time-varying controls; synthetic data
probit and IV (LnUnit instrumented by pandemic/treated) at product level; not a DiD

data_provenance_note: README: synth_data_one.csv and synth_data_two.dta contain made-up numerical values to test the code; IQVIA data available only under a DUA (DUA.pdf shipped). Log files of runs on the original data are included.
software_notes: R (plm, lmtest) for Table 1; Stata for Table 2.
screener_notes: Common-onset COVID DiD, not staggered; synthetic data. Screened from package only (no article text).
